candidates.title: Synthetic Study of Retrieval Evidence and Unsupported Claims
candidates.abstract: In a controlled synthetic evaluation, adding retrieved passages reduced answers that asserted claims absent from the evidence. The improvement was largest when passages directly addressed the question.

candidates.title: Synthetic Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering Across Domains
candidates.abstract: Retrieval augmentation improved answer support on some domains but had little effect when retrieved passages were incomplete or off topic. Aggregate factuality changes depended on retrieval coverage.

candidates.title: Synthetic Measurements of Porous Ceramic Catalysts Under Thermal Cycling
